positions.title: Intern - Website developer
positions.description:
Working with PHP to achieve a website that was capable of maintaining records of information for the management department as well as for the purchasing department.  I created a website that works with a database, MySQL, to record when a person takes a day off or will only work part of the day. On this project I worked along with the office manager to be able to create a program that met their needs.  On the website, she is able to record and also be able to pull out reports whenever she wishes.  The reports can include just one year of record or since the database was created for a specific person or group.  Also this database works with an external site that is within the internal site, that helps people see when a person will not be attending work for any reason.
The second part of my project was to create a site that was able to keep track of inventory for the purchasing department.  This site allows them to report where a specific item is, create a report that notifies them what items are missing at a specific location.  There is another part of the site where any person that has access to the internal site can be able to pull out reports that are either in excel format or pdf.  The reports that are created by the site are made using fpdf, which is an open source code that works along with php. Most of the work done on this projects were using PHP, HTML, CSS, and some JavaScript

projects.title: Building a Useful California Department of Education Database
projects.description: We worked with data that gets published by California Board of Education every year. This data talks about public schools here in California, the data collected ranges from K-12 grade. The idea of the project was to import the excel spreadsheets that are being published into a database that would allow the Office of Institutional Research at CSU-Stanislaus do research. The Office of Institutional Research was interested in running queries that would allowed them to see the trends that occur every year with students coming to the university. The data is not just found in excel format, it is also found in older database formats. Once the data was uploaded into the database successfully, we worked on optimizing the database so that queries could return a result on a quicker time. The data on the tables ranged from 50,000 records up to 100,000 at the time of import.

projects.title: Predicting WPST Performance by Application of Data Mining Techniques
projects.description: We work with data that has been collected over the years from students that take the Writing Proficiency Screening Test. The purpose of this project was to attempt in discovering the reasons why student pass and do not pass the exam on their first attempt. The project consisted in analyzing the data and in a way normalizing it to see if we could find a possibility in why students were not successful. Some of the technologies we used to work on this project were Weka, MySQL, and Excel. At the end of the project we found that there were not enough information for us to conclude with a decision on why some students were successful on their first attempt and others were not.
